text:
Maria (CSM): Quick heads-up — ACME Retail just moved to "low engagement" on the account health dashboard and finance flagged their upcoming renewal as "at-risk" for 2025-06-01.
Nick (Customer Success Manager): Thanks Maria. Do we have recent usage/feature gaps?
Maria (CSM): Usage dropped 45% month-over-month. They've only been using embeddings + a single generation route. Onboarding notes say they paused integration after last release due to latency spikes.
Jake (Solutions Eng): I remember a perf regression in v1.9 rollout — likely KV cache was misconfigured for their traffic pattern. Can validate quickly.
Elaine (Account Exec): Renewal conversation next week. We need a short save plan + downgrade option to present. Prefer a one-pager they can digest.
Maria (CSM): Proposed triage workflow: 1) Quick health call (owner: Maria) — confirm current blockers 2) Perf triage & temporary routing change to lower-latency model variant (owner: Jake) 3) Short-term credit + usage incentive (owner: Elaine) 4) Enablement workshop to ramp use to critical paths (owner: Nick) 5) Capture feedback and commit a roadmap item if needed.
Nick (Customer Success Manager): Can we make the enablement workshop <45 minutes and focused on 2/3 high-impact integrations? Less friction.
Jake (Solutions Eng): Yep. I can prep a demo that shows a config tweak and the immediate latency delta. Rough steps I plan:
```
- switch route to "redwood-low-latency-v2"
- confirm KV cache warming using /internal/kv-warm endpoint
- monitor p99 with quick script (5m window)
```
Maria (CSM): I'll schedule the call for tomorrow 10am PT and set agenda items: problems, immediate fixes, rollback plan, and next steps. Elaine — can you confirm the incentive we can offer (credit or discounted renewal month)?
Elaine (Account Exec): We can offer 20% credit on next invoice OR a temporary 2-week premium trial of Dedicated tier at no charge. Suggest pitching the Dedicated trial as "try improved latency with no commit".
Maria (CSM): Good — that gives a clear pilot. Ops Bot: alert created #INC-ACME-0921, assigned to Jake.
Nick (Customer Success Manager): I'll prepare a one-pager save plan to share in the renewal meeting: short problem statement, proposed mitigation (config + trial), timeline, success metrics (>=60% re-engagement, p99 < 250ms), and next steps.
Jake (Solutions Eng): I'll run the routing change during the call and have logs/screens ready. If latency improves, we show it live.
Maria (CSM): Action items recap (owners): Maria — schedule + host health call; Jake — perf triage + live demo; Elaine — confirm incentive language and legal ok; Nick — one-pager + enablement agenda. Aim to have materials ready 6 hours before renewal touchpoint.
Elaine (Account Exec): I'll loop legal now.
Maria (CSM): Also capturing feedback: will send a short 3-question survey after the workshop to capture friction points and likelihood to renew.
Nick (Customer Success Manager): If the live demo doesn't move the needle, fallback is a formal downgrade path: 1) downgrade to a lower-cost model with a 2-month guaranteed SLA, 2) phased migration playbook, 3) dedicated migration support hours. We'll present this only if they ask for lower cost.
Maria (CSM): Perfect. I'll post the prep doc here and tag folks when done. :thumbsup:
_reserved_note: This thread is a single Slack conversation about a churn prevention triage for ACME Retail. Messages are chronological and include short technical snippets and action owners.
